items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Social life, my brother and I were hanging out with Buddy. The other guys, of course were somewhere else. Wes was hanging out with one group of people, and Monk was hanging out somewhere else.

ctx.x: Musically, every day they were together. Social life, my brother and I were hanging out with Buddy. The other guys, the older guys, of course were somewhere else. Wes was hanging out with one group of people, and Monk was hanging out somewhere else.

Can you think of other activities that were going on in your community that so involved a group of young people that became the center of their lives, the way music had become for you, for the Montgomerys, and for others in that circle?
Yes. Sports, of course, like it always is. A lot of people were into sports.
